The Sun, lord of the 4th, joins Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th, in the 10th, a career house, forming Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga forms as the Sun, lord of the 4th, joins Mercury, lord of the 5th and of the 2nd, a career house, by conjunction in the 10th, a career house [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, in the 7th, the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam, and from the Sun, in the 10th from the Sun, a career house, its strength reduced by Saturn's aspect, an adverse tara from the Moon, and Mars standing in a placement the texts hold unable to give its good results [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].

The house vote is for career: although the 10th, a career house, in Aquarius is the weakest house weighed at 4.51 rupas, the 2nd at 8.93, the 11th from the Moon at 8.51 and the 11th from the Sun at 8.95 are strong [vote:career.house].

The lord vote is for career: Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in Pisces in the 11th with a shadbala ratio of 1.33 and Mars, lord of the 7th, the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam, is in its own sign with 1.3, while Saturn, lord of the 10th, sits in Taurus in the 1st in a friend's sign with a lower ratio of 0.69 [vote:career.lord].

The karaka vote is for career: the Sun and Mercury stand in the 10th, a career house, with shadbala ratios of 1.23 and 1.19, Venus is exalted in the 11th, a career house, with 1.33, and Saturn in the 1st is the weakest at 0.69 [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote is for career: in the dasamsa (D10) Mars is exalted in Capricorn and Saturn is in its own sign Capricorn, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus are in friendly signs, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

The panchanga vote is for career: Mars, lord of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 10th from the Sun, a career house, and the 2nd from the Moon, a career house, with a shadbala ratio of 1.3, and the Moon, lord of the weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon, a career house, with 1.27 [vote:career.panchanga].

Saturn, lord of the 10th, follows its sign chain through Venus in Pisces to the Jupiter–Venus loop and its nakshatra chain to the Mars–Mercury loop, while its navamsa chain ends in Saturn itself in Capricorn; Saturn is in neither current period's activation set [chain:career.lord].

The Sun, the main career significator, follows its sign chain through Saturn and Venus to the Jupiter–Venus loop, its nakshatra chain from PurvaBhadra to the Mars–Mercury loop, and its navamsa chain to Saturn; the current major period of Jupiter activates it, as the Sun sits in a nakshatra of Jupiter [chain:career.karaka].
